verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim cross-team dependency tracking for launches (connecting engineering, product, marketing; timeline/board views; progress visibility on priorities), which directly supports the story. However, there's no dedicated dependency-linking feature (e.g., blocking/blocked-by cross-project links) documented, and community feedback raises usability/reliability concerns (slow, buggy, confusing workflows) that could undermine coordination at scale. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dependency-linking mechanics across teams/projects, independent case studies of large launch coordination, and confirmation these features work smoothly in practice.
